permitted_extension_policy: Only the listed schema-valid ESPI resources are admitted. Non-ESPI entry content and unknown ESPI resources are fatal.

relationship_rules.IntervalBlock: one up link to its collection and one owning MeterReading related collection
relationship_rules.LocalTimeParameters: one up link to its collection and exactly one UsagePoint related reference
relationship_rules.MeterReading: one up link, exactly one UsagePoint owner, one ReadingType, and at least one IntervalBlock
relationship_rules.ReadingType: one up link to its collection and exactly one MeterReading related reference
relationship_rules.UsagePoint: exactly one self link, one up link, one supported MeterReading, and one LocalTimeParameters
